changelog.text: New Call Sheet node: the whole shot on one node, set in the Studio, with + Add in every group.
1 new Boudoir frame from Taylor: curled on a white windowsill in daylight.
10 new poses from two carousels: a Golden window set and a Stairwell set (in SFW, with one in Suggestive).
Body details moved from Suggestive to SFW (now S197 to S205).
31 new Boudoir prompts in four new sets: Gingham, Projector, Black bodysuit and Daylight studio.
147 new prompts from Instagram carousels. New sets: Autumn forest (SFW), Knit studio, Flannel and Body details (Suggestive), plus more Everyday, Outdoor, Fashion, Places, Selfie and Portrait poses.
8 more SFW web finds from a second Instagram carousel: doorway, balcony, sofa and home poses.
3 lakeside frames (S76, S77, S78) reworded so they work with scenes. The boat and the lake now sit in the setting sentence.
5 new SFW web finds: lakeside and boat poses from an Instagram carousel.
34 prompts reworded so more of them work with scenes and outfits. The pose, the clothes and the place now sit in their own sentences.
41 new SFW prompts in three new sets: fashion poses, places, and everyday poses.
Build a person now opens from the top bar anywhere on the page.
Build a person: pick gender, build, height, hair, eyes, skin and complexion, then add that person to every prompt.
New Light & Angle tab with recipes for true side views and dark, back lit scenes.
Style switch, Copy set buttons, Starred tab and this guide.
SFW 18 to 22 no longer describe the person, so your LoRA's likeness wins.

frames.title: Overhead, upside down
frames.text: [trigger] in a soft boudoir photograph, lying on her back with her head toward the camera so the frame reads upside down, bare shoulders, lips slightly parted, gazing straight up into the lens. Hair spread loosely around her head on a pale surface. Tight overhead close-up, 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Soft diffused window light from above, muted warm tones, gentle film grain and low contrast.

frames.title: Arm over head, wall sun
frames.text: [trigger] in an airy boudoir photograph, standing nude against a plain white wall, one forearm resting across the top of her head, the other hand raised beside her jaw, hips shifted to one side, eyes half closed. Medium full shot from slightly below, eye level lens. Hard window sunlight casts bright rectangular patches across the wall to the right. Soft pale gray and white palette, clean matte finish.

frames.title: Paper sheet, reclined
frames.text: [trigger] in a boudoir photograph, lying on a white seamless paper backdrop with a loose sheet of paper pulled across her torso and hips, one hand pressed to her temple, the other holding the paper to her chest, knees bent to the side. A large roll of paper curls across the top of the frame. High angle tilted overhead shot, wide lens. Soft window light, creamy whites, subtle grain.

frames.title: Leaning on both hands
frames.text: [trigger] in an implied nude boudoir photograph, leaning forward on both hands on a white surface, shoulders angled toward the camera, chest concealed, calm direct gaze into the lens. Plain light gray backdrop. Medium shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel, soft focus falloff. Soft window light from the left with faint hand shadows on the surface. Muted warm whites, low contrast, light grain.

frames.title: Torn paper, glance away
frames.text: [trigger] in a boudoir photograph, lying on her back on white paper, one hand gripping the edge of a torn paper sheet folded over her torso, the other hand resting on her chest, glancing sideways out of frame with lips parted. Crumpled paper edges frame the left side. Close overhead medium shot, 50mm lens feel. Soft even daylight, ivory and cream palette, gentle film grain.

frames.title: Paper dress, sun stripes
frames.text: [trigger] in a boudoir photograph, seated on the floor with legs folded to one side, crumpled white paper wrapped around her torso and hips like a strapless dress, leaning back on one hand, looking up into the lens. Crinkled paper backdrop rises behind her. High angle shot looking down, wide lens. Hard sunlight through a window throws bright slanted stripes across her legs and the floor. Cool white palette, soft grain.

frames.title: Over the shoulder
frames.text: [trigger] in an intimate boudoir portrait, implied nude, body turned away with a bare shoulder raised toward the camera, looking back over the shoulder into the lens. Plain pale gray backdrop. Close medium shot, 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Soft diffused window light from the left, gentle shadow on the far side. Muted warm and desaturated tones, low contrast, fine film grain.

frames.title: Paper wrap at the curtains
frames.text: [trigger] in a bright boudoir photograph, standing in front of floor length sheer white curtains, a large crumpled sheet of white paper held against her body as a wrap, head tilted back with eyes closed, one hand at her jaw, the other spread on her hip. Low angle medium shot, wide lens. Strong backlight from the window glowing through the curtains, airy overexposed highlights, soft cream palette.

frames.title: Overhead, arms crossed
frames.text: [trigger] in a boudoir photograph, lying on her back on a seamless backdrop, arms crossed over her chest, one knee raised, head toward the camera so she looks up into the lens from an upside down angle. Hair fanned around her head. Direct overhead full body shot, 35mm lens feel. Soft even studio light, pale warm gray backdrop, gentle grain.

frames.title: Feet detail
frames.text: [trigger] in a minimal boudoir detail shot, lying on her side with legs bent and bare feet crossed, soles facing the camera. Plain light gray seamless backdrop. Tight close-up on the feet and calves, low angle at floor level, 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Soft diffused side light. Muted warm tones, matte finish, visible film grain.

frames.title: Standing, hands low
frames.text: [trigger] in a fine art boudoir photograph, standing nude with hands crossed low in front of her hips, knees together with one heel lifted, head tilted down and eyes lowered. Dark polish on the toenails. Plain pale gray backdrop with a soft patch of window light on the wall to the right. Full length shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel. Soft diffused light, cool muted palette, light grain.

frames.title: Antique hairbrush
frames.text: [trigger] in a boudoir photograph, implied nude, lying on her side on the floor propped on one elbow, gazing down at an antique tarnished silver hairbrush cradled in both hands. Plain light gray backdrop. Medium close shot from a low angle, 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Soft window light from the right. Muted warm tones, desaturated finish, gentle grain.

frames.title: Bodysuit crouch
frames.text: [trigger] in a casual boudoir photo, crouching on one knee, head tilted, hand resting on her knee. Wearing a black ribbed sleeveless mock neck bodysuit and white block heel ankle boots. Small apartment bedroom with herringbone wood floor, wooden dresser, white paneled door, wall calendar print, shag rug and a work desk. Low angle wide shot, phone camera look. Indoor overhead lighting, neutral tones.

frames.title: Mirror selfie
frames.text: [trigger] in a candid boudoir mirror selfie, holding a phone up to a full length mirror, biting the hem of an oversized white t-shirt lifted to her ribs, wearing a gray cotton thong with a wide logo waistband and black knee high boots. Lived in bedroom with a mid-century wooden dresser, framed print, clothes piled on the dresser and a patterned red and navy rug. Warm lamp light, slightly dim phone camera finish.

frames.title: Flash on the bed
frames.text: [trigger] in a playful boudoir photo, lying on a bed in a white scoop neck one-piece bodysuit, one arm raised overhead making a peace sign, one knee bent, tugging at the leg opening. Blue patterned quilt, white pillows, a cluttered nightstand and a poster on the floor below. Overhead tilted shot, 35mm wide lens. Direct on-camera flash, bright whites and cool blues, 35mm film color and grain.

frames.title: Armchair, from behind
frames.text: [trigger] in a soft boudoir photograph, seen from behind, kneeling on a cream bouclé armchair, glancing down over her shoulder, hair in a low bun. Wearing only a pale pink string thong. Sheer peach curtains hang in front of tall paned windows. Medium shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel. Diffused daylight filtering through the curtains, warm peach and cream palette, clean finish.

frames.title: Pink sofa, look back
frames.text: [trigger] in a boudoir photo, kneeling on a blush pink leather sofa with hands on the backrest, looking back over her shoulder into the lens. Wearing a cropped white satin top with flared bell sleeves, a white thong and white block heel sandals. White curtains behind. Medium shot from a slight high angle, 35mm lens feel. Direct on-camera flash, glossy satin highlights, pale pink and white palette, crisp finish.

frames.title: Sheepskin and pearls
frames.text: [trigger] in a romantic boudoir photograph, reclining back over a sheepskin throw with arms stretched overhead and head tipped back. Wearing a peach lace bralette with a strand of pearls draped across the neckline and ruffled tie side briefs. Rumpled cream sheets, a sheer white curtain and a gold patterned rug. High angle medium shot, 35mm lens feel. Warm natural window light, honey and cream tones, soft film finish.

frames.title: Glasses bite
frames.text: [trigger] in a gritty boudoir photo, standing in a small bathroom against a glossy brown vinyl shower curtain, white square tile wall and towel bar on the left, wearing a blue ribbed cropped tank and a white thong, biting the temple of black eyeglasses, the other hand hooked in the waistband. Medium shot at eye level, 35mm lens feel. Harsh direct flash with specular shine on the curtain, dark warm palette, heavy grain.

frames.title: Lifted tank, flash
frames.text: [trigger] in a gritty boudoir photo, wearing round black eyeglasses, a blue ribbed cropped tank lifted at the hem by one hand and a white thong, other arm swung out to the side, lips parted, staring into the lens. Glossy brown vinyl shower curtain behind. Low angle medium shot, 35mm lens feel. Harsh direct on-camera flash, hard shadows and shine on the curtain, deep brown palette, heavy film grain.

frames.title: Gripping the doorframe
frames.text: [trigger] in a gritty boudoir photo, standing in a narrow bathroom doorway gripping both sides of the white door frame, leaning slightly forward with one knee raised, lips parted, staring down into the lens. Wearing round black eyeglasses, a blue ribbed cropped tank and a white thong. Dim bathroom behind with tile, a sink and a dark shower curtain. Low angle medium shot, 35mm lens feel. Harsh direct flash, cool shadows, heavy film grain.

frames.title: Doorway by the fridge
frames.text: [trigger] in a candid boudoir photo, leaning against the white frame of an open bathroom doorway, one hand tugging the side of a white thong, the other tucked behind her back, ankles crossed and heels lifted, wearing a blue ribbed cropped tank. Beside her a white refrigerator covered in instant photos and magnets, brown shower curtain and toilet visible in the bathroom behind. Full length shot at eye level, 35mm lens feel. Direct flash, cool muted tones, film grain.

frames.title: Arms up, shower curtain
frames.text: [trigger] in a gritty boudoir photo, standing against a brown vinyl shower curtain with both arms raised overhead, one hand reaching up with fingers spread, head tilted back, lips parted, gazing down into the lens through round black eyeglasses. Wearing a blue ribbed cropped tank and a white thong. Shower rod and white tile at the upper left. Low angle medium close shot, 35mm lens feel. Harsh direct flash, deep brown and slate blue palette, film grain.

frames.title: Folded forward on the bed
frames.text: [trigger] in a clean boudoir photograph, seen from behind, kneeling on a white bed and folded forward with her head resting on one forearm, feet tucked together at the edge of the mattress. Wearing a rust red scoop back bralette and matching thong. Crisp white sheets and pillows, a cream quilted blanket across the foot of the bed. Direct overhead shot, 35mm lens feel. Soft even daylight, white and rust palette, crisp natural finish.

frames.title: Cabin doorway, red robe
frames.text: [trigger] in a sunlit boudoir photo, standing in the open front doorway of a wood cabin, holding a sheer deep red robe open off her shoulders, wearing a dark red lace bra and matching briefs, white knee socks and black knee high boots, looking down. Black paneled door with a fall flower wreath, covered porch with timber beams, a propane tank and scattered autumn leaves behind. Full length shot at eye level, phone camera look. Strong afternoon backlight, warm reds and golds.

frames.title: Kneeling, head bowed
frames.text: [trigger] in a moody outdoor portrait, kneeling with hands resting on her knees, head bowed and eyes lowered, hair blowing across her face. Wearing a white chiffon tie neck blouse with ruffled cuffs, a brown plaid midi skirt and sheer black tights. An overgrown field with a blurred abandoned brick church with slate roofs and a tower behind. Medium shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Flat overcast daylight, muted greens and browns, soft film grain.

frames.title: Windblown, eyes closed
frames.text: [trigger] in a windswept outdoor portrait, standing with eyes closed and head tilted, hair streaming sideways in the wind, one arm wrapped across her waist, the other hand catching the hem of a billowing brown plaid skirt. Medium shot from slightly below, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Overcast sky, muted greens, soft grain.

frames.title: Seated overhead, hair flying
frames.text: [trigger] in a dreamy outdoor portrait, seated on the ground, head tipped toward one shoulder with eyes closed, hair whipping out to the side in the wind, hands resting in her lap. Wearing a white chiffon tie neck blouse, a brown plaid skirt and sheer black tights. Grass and bare dirt fill the frame. High angle shot looking down, 35mm lens feel. Soft overcast daylight, deep greens and warm browns, gentle film grain.

frames.title: Profile, face hidden

frames.title: Clock tower, low angle
frames.text: [trigger] in a windswept outdoor portrait, seated low on the ground with knees drawn up, head tilted with eyes closed, hair streaming sideways in the wind, hands folded on her knee. Wearing a white chiffon tie neck blouse, a brown plaid skirt and sheer black tights. Grass with a tall brick clock tower with a pointed slate spire rises behind against a pale sky. frames.title: Holding the skirt
frames.text: [trigger] in an outdoor portrait, standing with head tilted back, hair blown across her face, both hands holding down a brown plaid skirt as the wind lifts it. Wearing a white chiffon blouse with ruffled cuffs and sheer black tights. A field with an abandoned brick church with a clock tower and spire blurred behind. Medium shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Overcast daylight, muted greens and browns, soft grain.

frames.title: Look back by the poles
frames.text: [trigger] in an outdoor portrait, turning to look back over her shoulder into the lens, arms wrapped around herself, hair blowing behind her. Wearing a white long sleeve blouse and a swinging brown plaid midi skirt. Overgrown field with tall golden grass, a mossy wall, concrete blocks and wooden utility poles behind. Medium full shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Bright flat overcast sky, soft greens and tans, light grain.

frames.title: Hands in hair
frames.text: [trigger] in an outdoor portrait, kneeling with both hands raised into her hair, eyes lowered, lips parted. Wearing a white chiffon tie neck blouse with wide sleeves and a brown plaid skirt spread around her. Tall dry grass with seed heads framing the edges. High angle medium shot, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Soft dusky overcast light, golden olive palette, film grain.

frames.title: Projection, direct gaze
frames.text: [trigger] in a dark projection portrait, looking straight into the lens with lips pressed together, an abstract projected image casting bands of lavender, gold and white light across her face. Wearing a deep red top with lace sleeves and dangling starfish and pink pearl earrings. Dark gray wall behind catching blurred colored projection. Close medium shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel. Projector as the only light source, deep shadows, moody low key finish.

frames.title: Rainbow streak
frames.text: [trigger] in a dark projection portrait, head tilted, looking into the lens with hair falling over one eye, streaks of rainbow projected light sweeping diagonally across her cheek and lips. Wearing a deep red lace top and starfish earrings with pink pearl drops. Dark wall behind with a soft blurred projected glow. Close up at eye level, 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Single projector light, rich shadows, low key finish.

frames.title: Looking up, lavender bands
frames.text: [trigger] in a dark projection portrait, gazing up and off to the side with lips parted, horizontal bands of lavender and white projected light across her face, a warm orange glow spilling onto her neck. Wearing a deep red lace top. Dark wall behind with a blurred violet projection. Close medium shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel. Projector light only, deep blue black shadows, moody low key finish.

frames.title: Floral projection
frames.text: [trigger] in a dark projection portrait, head slightly bowed, looking up into the lens, a projected image of blurred flowers and warm amber tones falling across her face and the wall behind. Wearing a deep red top with lace sleeves and dangling earrings. Medium close shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Projector as the main light, warm highlights against dark shadows, low key finish.

frames.title: Car seat selfie
frames.text: [trigger] in a casual phone selfie, reclined in the front passenger seat of a parked car with one hand raised into her hair and one knee drawn up, giving a soft closed mouth smile. Wearing a fitted black cropped t-shirt with a small white line art cherub graphic, charcoal black cargo pants, white leather sneakers, a silver rosary style necklace and layered silver chain bracelets. Cream perforated leather seats and black door trim, a red sedan and a silver pickup truck in the parking lot outside. High angle arm's length selfie with a wide phone lens, her outstretched arm entering the lower right corner, deep focus. Hard afternoon sunlight through the windshield, crisp warm highlights and sharp shadows, natural saturated color.

frames.title: Lace bralette, over the shoulder
frames.text: [trigger] in an editorial portrait, body turned in profile with arms extended down and forward out of frame, looking back over her shoulder into the lens with a calm, direct gaze. Wearing a white floral lace bralette with thin straps and a white ruffled eyelet skirt, flushed terracotta blush and glossy peach lips. Plain seamless dusty mauve pink studio wall. Medium shot at eye level, 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field, generous negative space on the left. Soft diffused frontal light with almost no shadow. Muted warm palette, lifted matte blacks, low contrast, fine 35mm film grain, wide white print border.

frames.title: Bathroom mirror selfie
frames.text: [trigger] in a casual mirror selfie, holding a black phone up to the mirror and smiling while glancing toward the screen. Wearing a fitted black cropped t-shirt with a sparkly rhinestone leaping cat logo on the chest, heather gray sweatpants, a small silver ear stud and stacked red string and silver charm bracelets. Glossy white wall tiles laid on the diagonal with a gray scrollwork border tile, dark charcoal marble look tiles below, a wooden door frame with a white handle and a blush pink wall at the right edge. Medium close shot at a slightly high angle, framed from the hips up, deep focus. Soft overhead indoor light, slightly cool, gentle shadows. Faint water spots on the mirror, slightly soft phone camera finish, natural color.

frames.title: Straw in mouth, mirror
frames.text: [trigger] in a casual mirror selfie, standing with one hand on her hip and the other holding up a mint green phone, a lavender plastic straw held between her lips, glancing sideways at the mirror with a deadpan expression. Wearing a slate gray scoop neck tank with the hem gathered up at her waist and low rise pink striped boxer shorts with a small burgundy bow at the waistband. Plain off white wall and a white door with dark hinges behind. Medium shot from the thighs up at eye level, phone camera look, deep focus. Dim warm indoor light, soft shadows. Muted warm tones, slightly soft and grainy phone finish.

frames.title: Railing at sunset
frames.text: [trigger] in a candid outdoor photo, leaning sideways against a black metal railing with one hand gripping the rail, head tilted to rest on her raised shoulder, smiling softly into the lens. Wearing a charcoal gray waffle knit henley with white buttons, a black pleated corduroy mini skirt, sheer black tights, slouchy gray knit leg warmers, chunky black platform lace up shoes and a black shoulder bag. Golden autumn shrubs behind the railing, a fenced concrete reservoir reflecting the sky, evergreen branches and distant high rise towers. Full length shot at eye level, phone camera look, deep focus. Sunset sky glowing yellow and peach, soft warm ambient light on her. Amber, charcoal and evergreen palette, crisp natural finish.

frames.title: Hotel window, morning
frames.text: [trigger] in a soft boudoir photograph, sitting sideways on a wide hotel window ledge with knees drawn up, holding a coffee cup in both hands and gazing out at the city. Wearing only an oversized white men's dress shirt slipping off one shoulder. Rumpled white bed blurred in the foreground. Medium shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Bright morning backlight through sheer curtains, soft haze, cream and pale blue palette, light film grain.

frames.title: Velvet chaise
frames.text: [trigger] in a moody boudoir photograph, reclining on an emerald velvet chaise in a black silk slip with one strap fallen from the shoulder, one arm draped along the backrest, looking into the lens. Dark green walls, a brass floor lamp and a stack of old books. Medium full shot from a low angle, 35mm lens feel. Single warm tungsten lamp from the right, deep falloff into shadow, rich green and amber palette, fine grain.

frames.title: Milk bath
frames.text: [trigger] in a fine art boudoir photograph, implied nude, lying back in a white clawfoot tub filled with milky water, shoulders and knees just above the surface, pale pink rose petals floating around her, eyes closed. White subway tile and a small window behind. Direct overhead shot, 35mm lens feel. Soft diffused daylight from the window, milky whites and blush pink, low contrast, gentle grain.

frames.title: Sheet tangle, top down
frames.text: [trigger] in an intimate boudoir photograph, lying on her stomach across rumpled white linen with a sheet draped over her hips, bare back toward the camera, chin resting on folded arms, glancing up into the lens. Overhead full length shot, 35mm lens feel. Soft morning window light raking across the folds of the sheets from the left, warm whites, delicate shadows, light film grain.

frames.title: Vintage vanity
frames.text: [trigger] in a glamorous boudoir photograph, seated at a vintage vanity, fastening a pearl earring, her face reflected in a round mirror ringed with warm bulbs. Wearing a cream lace bodysuit. Perfume bottles, a velvet jewelry box and a silk robe over the chair. Medium shot over her shoulder, 50mm lens feel, focus on the reflection. Warm bulb light from the mirror, golden and ivory palette, soft glow.

frames.title: Rain window silhouette
frames.text: [trigger] in a cinematic boudoir photograph, implied nude, standing at a tall rain streaked window with a sheer gray curtain wrapped loosely around her body, one hand pressed to the glass, face turned in profile. Dim apartment interior. Medium full shot from behind and to the side, 35mm lens feel. Cool blue dusk light through the wet glass with soft streaks of city light, near silhouette, slate blue palette, film grain.

frames.title: Laundromat at night
frames.text: [trigger] in a candid night photograph, sitting on top of a running washing machine, legs swinging, reading a paperback. Wearing an oversized cream cable knit sweater, a plaid skirt and white socks with loafers. Rows of front loading machines, a vending machine and a dark street outside the window. Medium full shot at eye level, 35mm lens feel. Flat green tinted fluorescent overhead light, mint and cream palette, 35mm film grain.

frames.title: Orchard ladder
frames.text: [trigger] in a warm outdoor photograph, standing halfway up a wooden orchard ladder reaching for an apple with a woven basket on her arm, smiling down at the camera. Wearing a loose linen dress with rolled sleeves. Apple trees heavy with red fruit, long grass below. Low angle medium full shot, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Golden hour sun backlighting the leaves, warm amber and green palette, soft film finish.

frames.title: Rooftop at blue hour
frames.text: [trigger] in a cinematic city photograph, standing on a gravel rooftop near the ledge in a long camel trench coat billowing in the wind, hands in her pockets, looking out over the skyline. Water towers and lit office windows behind. Full length shot from a low angle, 35mm lens feel. Blue hour sky with warm city lights below, cool blue and tungsten orange contrast, subtle grain.

frames.title: Library stacks
frames.text: [trigger] in a quiet interior photograph, leaning against tall wooden bookshelves in a narrow library aisle, reading an open hardcover. Wearing a chunky brown cardigan, a white collared blouse and wire rim glasses. Rows of old leather spines stretch into soft focus. Medium shot down the aisle, 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Warm light from a green banker's lamp at the end of the aisle, dust in the air, brown and gold palette, fine grain.

frames.title: Diner booth in the rain
frames.text: [trigger] in a nostalgic night photograph, sitting in a red vinyl diner booth with her chin in her hand, a strawberry milkshake with two straws in front of her. Wearing a denim jacket over a striped tee. Rain streaked window beside her with a pink and blue neon sign glowing outside. Medium shot at table height, 35mm lens feel. Neon light spilling through the wet glass mixed with warm overhead light, saturated reds and pinks, 35mm film grain.

frames.title: Lighthouse cliff
frames.text: [trigger] in a windswept coastal photograph, standing with hair blowing across her face, looking out into the distance. Wearing a long navy wool coat and a cream knit scarf. A grassy cliff edge above the sea, a white lighthouse on the headland behind and gray waves breaking below. Wide full length shot from slightly below, 35mm lens feel. Overcast diffused daylight, muted navy, sage and stone palette, soft grain.

frames.title: Pulling up a stocking
frames.text: [trigger] in a soft boudoir photograph, seated on the edge of a bed, leaning forward to draw a sheer black stocking up over one knee with both hands, eyes lowered. Wearing a black lace bodysuit and a satin robe slipping off one shoulder. Rumpled ivory sheets and a tufted headboard behind. Medium shot from a low angle, 50mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Soft window light from the left, ivory and black palette, fine film grain.

frames.title: Stomach down, ankles crossed
frames.text: [trigger] in a playful boudoir photograph, lying on her stomach diagonally across a bed, propped on her forearms with knees bent and ankles crossed in the air, chin resting on one hand, smiling into the lens. Wearing a blush pink satin camisole and matching shorts. White duvet and scattered pillows. Eye level shot from the foot of the bed, 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field. Bright diffused morning light, blush and white palette, clean finish.

frames.title: Legs up the headboard
frames.text: [trigger] in a boudoir photograph, lying on her back across a bed with both legs raised and resting crossed against a wooden headboard, one arm stretched overhead, the other hand resting on her stomach, face turned toward the camera. Wearing an oversized white button up shirt and white knee socks. Cream linen bedding. Side angle medium full shot at mattress height, 35mm lens feel. Warm late afternoon window light, honey and cream tones, soft film grain.

frames.title: Chaise recline, one leg long
frames.text: [trigger] in a moody boudoir photograph, leaning back along a burgundy velvet chaise with one leg extended and the other knee bent, one elbow propped on the armrest, hand at her temple, steady gaze into the lens. Wearing a champagne silk slip dress. Dark paneled wall and a heavy curtain behind. Medium full shot at eye level, 50mm lens feel. Single soft key light from the right, deep shadow falloff, burgundy and gold palette, fine grain.

frames.title: Kneeling, glance back
